Name: No More Flies
Author: Aledixx
Description:
If you are like me and hate the bugs and flies from the caves, this mod is for you. It replaces the sprites with little fairy slimes and the sounds with bells.
It's a work in progress and haven't tested it completely yet but I'm working on it.

1.1.0 update: Now you can choose what sound you want in the Generic Mod config Menu
Bells: Original bell sound
Lighter Bells: Original bell sound but a little less scandalous (in case you don't lower volume to almost zero like I do)
Harp: Lirical harp sound that has a tiny silence.
Light Wing Flap: the sound that a fairy would make by flying (in case you don't mind this type of sounds)

1.2.0 smoother grubs
1.3.0 no more buzzing fly ambient sound in summer, only birds.
1.4.0 better looking assassin bug
1.5.0 optional spider sprite change

future updates:
Tell me what you hate and I might give it a try

Downloads.Description: No more flies, no more insects and now no more spiders (optional)
